arabicExcerpts.text: وَنَحۡنُ أَقۡرَبُ إِلَيۡهِ مِنكُمۡ وَلَٰكِن لَّا تُبۡصِرُونَ
وَأَمَّآ إِن كَانَ مِنۡ أَصۡحَٰبِ ٱلۡيَمِينِ
وَأَمَّآ إِن كَانَ مِنَ ٱلۡمُكَذِّبِينَ ٱلضَّآلِّينَ

mainSubject.label: Oath by the settings of the stars declared most great if they could know, grounding a noble Quran held in a well-protected Register touched only by the purified, revealed from the Lord of the worlds; their indifference to this statement and their making denial the thanks for provision challenged; the deathbed scene where the soul reaches the throat while onlookers watch and unseen angels stand nearer, with the challenge to bring it back if no recompense awaits; the threefold outcome — rest, bounty and a garden of pleasure for the brought-near, peace for the companions of the right, and scalding accommodation with Hellfire burning for the astray deniers; all named the true certainty, closing again with exalting the name of the Lord, the Most Great
